meta.title: Lowgear Cycle Works | Bike repair in Hackney
meta.description: Bike repair workshop in a railway arch off Mare Street, Hackney. Servicing, same-day fixes, wheel building and steel frame restoration. Book or just turn up.

rationale: A railway arch workshop with couriers as customers wants an after-hours, garage feel: near-black page, one acid lime accent, tall condensed Big Shoulders headlines and hard square edges. The price ledger answers the owner's wish to show roughly what things cost, the giant figure and the hand-drawn steel frame say what the place is about, and a plain letter from Dami carries the frame restoration he loves. Contact comes last as big type because most people will ring or turn up.

props.title: What it costs

items.name: Puncture repair
items.description: Tube or patch, wheel refitted and pumped. Done while you wait.

items.name: Brake fix
items.description: Pads, cables and adjustment. Done while you wait.

items.name: Gear adjustment
items.description: Indexing, cable tension and a test ride round the block.

items.name: Basic service
items.description: Brakes, gears, chain, tyres and bolts checked and set up.

items.name: Full service
items.description: Strip, degrease, regrease and rebuild. Same day when you book early.

items.name: Wheel build
items.description: Rim, hub and spokes chosen with you, laced and trued by hand.

items.name: Steel frame restoration
items.description: Look at the frame together, then we give you a quote.

props.note: Prices are for labour. Parts are extra and we tell you the cost before we fit them.

items.name: Old steel frames
items.description: This is the part of the job Dami loves most. A tired steel frame comes in, gets stripped and checked, and leaves ready to ride again. Bring it in and we will look at it with you.

photo.subject: A bare steel road frame in a work stand inside the railway arch, paint half stripped, Dami's hands holding a rag

items.name: Wheel building
items.description: Rosa and Dami build wheels to suit how you ride, from a courier's daily slog to a commuter's quiet loop. Each one is laced by hand and trued on the stand before it leaves.

photo.subject: A wheel in a truing stand, spokes laced, Rosa's hand on the spoke key, workshop lights behind

paragraphs: Most of what comes through the arch is a commuter bike with a flat or a rubbing brake. Rosa and I fix those while you wait, and you ride off.
What I really love is old steel. A frame that has sat in a shed for years can be stripped, repaired and put back on the road, and I will happily spend days on one.
If you are a courier or you ride in every day, tell us when you need the bike back and we plan the day around it.
props.name: Dami

pairs.ask: Can I just turn up with a puncture?
pairs.answer: Yes. Punctures and brake fixes are done while you wait, as long as we are not in the middle of another job.

pairs.ask: I need the bike back today.
pairs.answer: Tell us when you drop it off. Book a service in the morning and we will aim to have it ready for the ride home.

pairs.ask: I don't know what is wrong with it.
pairs.answer: Wheel it in. We look at it with you, say what it needs and what it costs, and only then pick up a spanner.
Ring the workshop or press the button below. We will find you a slot.
